items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: Thad Jones also did some wonderful work for Joe, as well as Ernie Wilkins. Ernie Wilkins, he wrote the big, the arrangement on the big hit “Every Day”

ctx.x: Probably because Bird uses a number five —
Yeah, and Ernie uses number two. I think that’s one I blotted out from my memory conveniently.
Yeah, maybe so. That stays on my mind all the time, you know?
